env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# Structured listing retains the dependency's error and incomplete state.
cd client
logos list -e -f '{{.Incomplete}} {{len .DepsErrors}}' .
stdout '^true 1$'
go list -e -f '{{.Incomplete}} {{len .DepsErrors}}' .
stdout '^false 0$'

# Build errors stay on the dependency and are reported once.
! logos build .
cp stderr build.stderr
grep -count=1 '\[correctness::mixed_module\] module example.com/mixed' build.stderr

# Default listing must reject the same invalid module.
! logos list .
stderr '\[correctness::mixed_module\] module example.com/mixed'

-- client/go.mod --
module example.com/client

go 1.27

require example.com/mixed v0.0.0

replace example.com/mixed => ../mixed
-- client/p.go --
package client

import "example.com/mixed/g"

const Value = g.Value
-- mixed/go.mod --
module example.com/mixed

go 1.27
-- mixed/g/g.go --
package g

const Value = 1
-- mixed/l/l.lgo --
package l
